subject: Agent of Record + split invoicing for AU GST (OzRetail)
messages:
From: Susan Kelly <susan.kelly@ozretail.au>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts@ozretail.au
Date: 2026-10-29T22:12:00Z
Subject: Request: self-bill arrangement and GST handling for October invoices

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalising October cutover for our marketplace settlement and need to confirm how Redwood will handle GST on the platform fee. OzRetail is requesting that our accounting team be listed as the agent-of-record for self-billing so we can apply the reverse-charge treatment for downstream sellers where applicable.

Concrete asks:
- Can Redwood issue split invoices (platform fee separated from pass-through items) so we can apply reverse-charge on the platform portion where relevant?
- Will Redwood accept an agent-of-record declaration (signed by OzRetail) that allows our AP to self-bill on behalf of our sellers for marketplace transactions?
- We attached our GST registration certificate and a sample settlement CSV. Please confirm what evidence you need from our side and whether we should expect corrected invoices or credit notes.

We’re under a tight month-end schedule, so a quick confirmation of the required paperwork and a target timeline (ideally within 48h) would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Susan Kelly
Head of Finance Operations
OzRetail Pty Ltd
Attachments: OzRetail_GST_certificate.pdf; sample-settlement-oct.csv
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Kelly <susan.kelly@ozretail.au>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-30T02:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: self-bill arrangement and GST handling for October invoices

Hi Susan — thanks for the note and for sending the GST certificate. Happy to get this moving. A few clarifying points so Finance can scope the change correctly: 

1) Agent-of-record scope: will OzRetail sign an agent-of-record MOU that explicitly authorises OzRetail to self-bill only marketplace settlements for sellers on OzRetail’s platform? If the AOR covers multiple entities or third-party sellers we’ll need the list of legal entity names and ABNs.

2) Evidence we need from OzRetail:
   - Signed agent-of-record MOU (we’ve attached a short template).
   - Official ABN/GST number for the legal entity that will act as agent.
   - Example invoice lines and mapping rules for split (platform fee vs pass-through).

3) Tax treatment: Redwood can issue split invoices where the platform fee is invoiced to OzRetail and flagged for reverse-charge where the buyer is registered for GST and the supply qualifies. For pass-through disbursements we typically itemise but leave tax treatment to the seller/purchaser.

Internal note: please confirm if OzRetail needs us to zero-rate anything or to issue credit notes if they take agent-of-record responsibility for a past invoice period.

Next steps:
- If you can sign and return the attached self-bill template we’ll queue the split-invoice flow in Finance (expect 3–5 business days after receipt).
- Please provide one PP sample (CSV) mapping so we can validate a sample corrected invoice.

Attaching: redwood-self-bill-template.pdf (draft).

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Ben — forwarding OzRetail’s request (see below). Quick summary: OzRetail wants to be agent-of-record for self-billing so they can apply reverse-charge to platform fees for marketplace settlements. They sent GST cert and sample CSV.

Risk/ask for Finance:
- Can we accept an AOR MOU and treat OzRetail as the billing counterparty for platform fees going forward?
- If accepted, do we need to reissue invoices / apply credit notes for October settlements? OzRetail is pushing for an 48h turnaround for month-end.
- Proposed guardrails: require signed MOU + ABN + one sample reconciliation before reissuing any historical invoices; hold payment release until validation if there’s uncertainty.

If you’re OK, I’ll ask Susan to sign the template and will request the ABN and a mapping file. If not OK, advise what the minimum evidence is and whether we should limit this to prospective invoices only.

Hi Susan — quick follow-up with confirmation from our Finance team. We can support a self-billing / agent-of-record arrangement and issue split invoices for the platform fee, subject to the following conditions: 

What we need from OzRetail (items to return to us):
1) Signed Agent-of-Record MOU (attached template) — confirms OzRetail will self-bill marketplace settlements and accept tax responsibility for the platform portion.
2) Official ABN/GST number for the legal entity acting as agent-of-record.
3) One sample settlement CSV (mapping file) that shows how you want the platform fee separated from pass-through items.

Operational notes / timeline:
- Once we receive the signed MOU + ABN + sample mapping, Finance will validate and create a test corrected invoice (non-financial preview) within 48 hours.
- After validation, we can issue corrected invoices (or credit notes) for the October settlement period; anticipated processing time: 3–5 business days from receipt of signed paperwork.
- We’ll pin the workflow to prospective invoices by default; historical invoice corrections will be handled case-by-case and may require payment hold until reconciliation is complete.

Attachments included: redwood-self-bill-template.pdf; proposed-invoice-split.xlsx; OzRetail_GST_certificate.pdf

DocuSign link for AOR MOU: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC-12345
HubSpot case: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
